answer: Every identity posts a 400 POA dispute bond any peer can challenge by staking 100 POA; winning burns the attacker's bond and pays the challenger 150 POA, while losing burns the challenger's stake. Like a marble down a spiral chute, fakes cascade toward exposure: 1,000 sybils cost 400,000 POA, yet an opal fake earning at most 30 POA per epoch needs over 13,000 epochs to break even, far beyond the 16-epoch pending lifetime. Edge case: a rich attacker could flood challenges to harass honest agents; mitigation caps each agent to 3 challenges per epoch and locks 200 POA per challenger for 4 epochs.
